title: Outbroke II
html:
Quest Giver: Junior Exec Ivan

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 15 Poison Mutant Twins and 3 Poison Mutant Twin Leaders in Upper Frump's Misfortune then Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Junior Exec Ivan

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill 15 Poison Mutant Twins and 3 Poison Mutant Twin Leaders in Upper Frump's Misfortune then Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

Ok, so The Frump is a cut throat businessman, what can you do? He still pays well!

All I need you to do is what you did for me last: Kill 15 Poison Mutant Twins and 3 Poison Mutant Twin Leaders in the main areas of Upper Frump's Misfortune then return to me, Junior Exec Ivan, in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

Bravo. Keep it up and someone somewhere will notice you someday! Who knows, maybe that person's name may rhyme with clump? At any rate, let me know if you want to repeat this quest.

Objectives:

  • Slain Poison Mutant Twins
  • Slain Poison Mutant Twin Leaders

Client level range: 35–50
